parameter.name: mutations
parameter.description: A list of dev-aide mutation ops like {op: 'insert', at: [1,2], xml: '...'}

actions.script:
// Bridge to your local Qwen MCP Toolchain Map aiResult = ec.service.sync() .name("org.moqui.ai.AgiAiGatewayServices.run#OpenAiProxy") .parameters([ systemInstruction: "You are an expert Moqui developer. Analyze the file context. Return JSON operations.", userPrompt: "Prompt: ${prompt}\nFile: ${filePath}\nContext: ${outlineContext}", mode: "mutate", aiProfileName: "local-qwen" ]) .call()
// Parse AI returned mutations (using dev-aide's pure.apply format) context.mutations = aiResult.mutations ?: [] context.responseMessage = aiResult.completionText
